sharedPatchRequests.change: Retain CreateTaskInput.source/links and native field semantics. At PersonalTaskStore, add a narrowly scoped create-or-reuse entry point taking the already authority-resolved existing native ID (or an explicitly absent origin result) plus CreateTaskInput. A resolved existing ID returns that Task without creating, updating status or adding a duplicate link; a resolved but missing ID returns a deleted/unresolved result rather than recreating. An absent origin delegates to create with source and mapped fields. The server authority, not this in-memory store, resolves scoped origin and serializes native create plus journal commit. Adapter maps initial imported completion via existing native transitions, never a second status field. Do not overload source.id with a composite origin string. If prerequisites already expose an equivalent native entry point, reuse it and omit this addition.
sharedPatchRequests.reason: create currently always mints a native ID; importBundle merges only by ID. TaskLink has only kind/id/label, so it is provenance, not durable block/owner origin authority. A naive source-link dedup would also break completeTask, which intentionally copies links/source to the next occurrence.
sharedPatchRequests.verification: Within real serialized owner commands: repeated origin returns same native ref/revision; distinct scoped origin creates another Task; deleted mapped target is not resurrected; completeTask still creates exactly its supported next occurrence and replay never creates it twice.
sharedPatchRequests.missingPrerequisite: Accepted LSX-WP-004 create contract and LSX-WP-034 origin/receipt journal; store.ts alone cannot provide a durable transaction.

risks: Existing source links cannot encode block/revision/scoped owner/raw props; adding metadata directly to read-only types.ts is outside the current slice unless accepted dependencies provide it or the packet is amended.
LSX-WP-004 proposes patch/batch APIs, while this package requires creation. An accepted field-patch receipt alone does not establish a durable native-create seam.

Two authorities may commit Task creation and source materialization separately; without durable origin reservation/recovery, response loss or crash can create duplicates or falsely acknowledge both effects.
Native recurrence copies source/links; dedup based on source alone can suppress a legitimate next occurrence, while replay of completion can duplicate one without native idempotency.
Markdown line/path/title are not stable identity; current parser only discovers explicit caret blocks and checkbox line/text, so it cannot replace LSX-WP-006 accepted mapping.
parseNlDate is machine-local and ISO Date construction normalizes invalid dates; TaskNotes preview must not silently coerce date-only/timezone/RRULE inputs.

RS-BASE-01 describes a new registered CustomRecord kind while the later entity-model design uses page/contentKind; reconcile accepted foundational contract rather than invent another reference namespace for this task slice.

Legacy checkbox formulas, native relation counts and unified overlap policy are distinct semantics; changing taskCount to native count would violate the specified negative control.
